features: DATABASE CHANGES: TEN MIGRATIONS AND THREE SETTINGS MIGRATIONS, FIVE OF THEM WRITE DATA — The update runs ten new migrations and three settings migrations by itself. New structures: comment moderation for each communication and for each report, the discussion each comment belongs to, and on the repayment agreement the choice about the part of the instalment outside the agreement, the change log and the choice made in the succession. Writing data: one turns off the comments of all the communications that already exist; two create the new comment email preferences, with the state of the comment preferences each user already has; one creates in the Action inbox the «Da moderare» (to be moderated) tasks for whatever already awaits approval and closes the old comment and attachment tasks; one realigns the successions recorded with the previous version (the reminders for interest and charges passed to the heirs, and the deceased's repayment agreement closed by the succession). Of the settings: two add «Commenti delle comunicazioni in moderazione di serie» (Communication comments moderated by default; on) and «Commenti delle segnalazioni in moderazione di serie» (Ticket comments moderated by default; off); the third removes «Forza moderazione commenti» (Force comment moderation) and, if it was on, turns on the two new ones and moderation on all reports. Two new permissions, «Modifica propri commenti comunicazioni» and «Elimina propri commenti comunicazioni»; the update realigns the standard roles by itself. Requirements are unchanged. After updating, reload any pages that are already open.

CHANGED: EXISTING COMMUNICATIONS HAVE COMMENTS TURNED OFF — «Allow comments» was in the communication forms but there were no comments: the update turns it off on all existing communications, which also have «Moderate comments» on. You turn it on yourself, communication by communication, where you want the discussion: as long as moderation stays on, residents' comments await approval. A new communication starts with comments off, unless you turn them on.

CHANGED: WHO MODERATES AND WHO EDITS COMMENTS — Approving and hiding other people's comments, on reports and on communications, requires both access to the panel and the permission «Approva commenti segnalazioni» or «Approva commenti comunicazioni»; editing and deleting them requires access to the panel with «Modifica commenti …» and «Elimina commenti …»: the panel alone is no longer enough. The standard collaborator no longer moderates and no longer edits other people's comments: they edit and delete their own. To let someone moderate, give them a role you created with «Approva commenti segnalazioni» or «Approva commenti comunicazioni»: the standard roles are realigned at every update, and a permission added by hand to the «collaboratore» role is lost. The standard owner and supplier roles comment on communications (the comment appears at once where «Moderate comments» is off) and edit and delete their own comments. A role you created with panel access and without «Commenta segnalazioni» no longer comments on reports. «Moderate comments», on a communication or on a report, can be changed only by someone who can moderate those comments; for everyone else the checkbox is not there. With «Allow comments» off nobody writes or edits comments, not even the office; the existing ones stay visible. A comment that was already published and is then edited by someone who cannot publish straight away goes back to awaiting approval.

CHANGED: «FORZA MODERAZIONE COMMENTI» (FORCE COMMENT MODERATION) IS GONE — The general settings now have «Communication comments moderated by default» and «Ticket comments moderated by default»: they apply to new communications and new reports, and each of them then has its own «Moderate comments» checkbox. Anyone who had turned on «Forza moderazione commenti» finds the two new settings on and moderation on all existing reports.

CHANGED: THE COMMENT EMAILS — The notice of a comment awaiting approval goes to whoever can approve it: whoever has panel access and «Approva commenti segnalazioni» or «Approva commenti comunicazioni»; the permission without panel access is no longer enough. When a comment awaiting approval is approved, the others taking part in the discussion are told too, not only its author. The emails for communication comments have their own preferences, separate from those for reports, and start out like the comment preferences each user already has, which are now called «… (segnalazioni)» (… (reports)); there is also a preference for an edited comment that goes back to awaiting approval.

CHANGED: IN THE PORTAL, YOUR OWN ITEMS AWAITING APPROVAL — In the portal list the resident finds again the reports and communications they wrote that are awaiting approval, with their status; other people's pending ones are not shown. The portal counts include them, and the dashboard shows them among the latest.

CHANGED: THE ACTION INBOX AND WHAT AWAITS APPROVAL — Comments, attachments, communications, documents and agenda events awaiting approval sit in a group of their own, «Da moderare» (to be moderated), with one task per item in place of the old tasks; a comment published at once no longer creates a task. The «Da moderare» tasks do not count among the overdue ones or in the «Da quanto aspettano» (how long they have been waiting) chart; in the «Per tipo» (by type) chart they have their own bar, and the menu number counts them. The emails to administrators stay.

CHANGED: INTEREST FOR PEOPLE WITH A REPAYMENT AGREEMENT — For the instalments covered by an agreement, the interest proposal leaves out only the days from the day of the agreement onwards, while the agreement is in progress or was honoured to the end: the days from the due date (or the issue date) to the day before the agreement stay in the proposal. If the agreement lapses, or the calendar ends with unpaid instalments, the days of the agreement come back too. Days already recorded as interest do not come back into the proposal. On the part of an instalment that the agreement does not cover, by default interest keeps running: also for agreements already recorded on part of an instalment, which used to leave it out. The «Recupero dei crediti» (debt recovery) and «Rate scadute» (overdue instalments) guides explain it. It stays a proposal: it becomes a charge only when you record it.

CHANGED: THE REPORT AND COMMUNICATION PAGES — Comments are speech bubbles, and a comment awaiting approval has an amber background; «Approve» and «Show again» are icons next to «Edit» and «Delete», and an edited comment says «· edited». Actions on comments and attachments no longer reload the page. The bottom of the «Attachments» box looks like «Write a comment…», with the formats in the tooltip of the «i». The card on the right no longer has «Interactions»: «Locked» and «Featured» appear under the visibility when they apply; next to the title there is the priority icon. The communication page has «Read more» for long texts and, in the panel, the recipients.

NEW: COMMENTS ON COMMUNICATIONS — The communication page, in the panel and in the portal, has «Comments» next to «Attachments». A communication to buildings, one or more, has a single discussion: the office and the residents of every building it goes to read it and write in it, and when there is more than one building the office sees the writer's condominium next to their name. A communication to people, or a private one, has one discussion per person: the resident sees and writes only in their own, the office sees them all, and with more than three discussions the ones without comments are a single line with «Write». The form is the one used for report comments, closed until you open it, with the character counter; whoever moderates sees «N in attesa» (N pending). Moderation is chosen for each communication («Moderate comments», on by default), and the office publishes at once. In the discussion the comment carries the name of the contact record of whoever wrote it, or the account name if they have none. Removing a building from the recipients also hides the comments written from there, and they come back if it is added again.
NEW: MODERATION FOR EACH REPORT — Each report has its own «Moderate comments» checkbox, which starts from the general setting.

NEW: HOW MANY COMMENTS AND ATTACHMENTS IN THE LISTS — In the communication and report lists, in the panel and in the portal, under the title there is how many comments and attachments each one has. In the portal the resident counts only those they see on the page. In the panel, under the title there is also what is waiting for approval: «N comments to approve», «N attachments to approve».

NEW: THE «COMMENTS» PAGE — In the panel menu, next to «Attachments», the «Comments» page lists in one place the comments on reports and communications of all the condominiums, with filters for status, type, condominium, author and dates. From the row: «Open on the page», «Reply» and «Edit» in a window, «Approve», «Hide», «Show again», «Delete»; with a selection, «Approve selected», «Hide selected», «Show selected again» and «Delete selected». Each action is there only if the page allows it to you, and sends the same emails as the page. Whoever does not moderate sees the published comments and their own awaiting approval. A hidden comment becomes visible again with «Show again», also from the page of the report or communication, without an email to its author. On the page of the report or communication, whoever can make it visible again reads it in grey, marked «Hidden»; the numbers on the page do not count it.

NEW: «DA MODERARE» IN THE ACTION INBOX — The sixth card «Da moderare» (to be moderated) and the group with one task for each report, communication, document or event that has something awaiting approval («2 comments and 1 attachment awaiting approval»), since when it has been waiting, and the next action that opens the right page already filtered («Modera i commenti» (moderate the comments), «Modera gli allegati» (moderate the attachments)). The task is seen and closed only by whoever can moderate that item; it closes by itself when nothing is left awaiting approval and reopens if something new arrives, including a published comment that is edited and goes back to awaiting approval.

NEW: THE CHOICE ABOUT THE PART OUTSIDE THE AGREEMENT — In the repayment agreement window, «Sulla parte della rata fuori dall'accordo» (On the part of the instalment outside the agreement): «gli interessi continuano» (interest keeps running, the default) or «restano sospesi finché l'accordo regge» (stays suspended while the agreement holds), with the «i» that explains it with an example. The choice can also be changed later, from the agreement page, with «Cambia la scelta sulla parte fuori» (Change the choice about the outside part), until the agreement is closed: from then on the interest proposal follows the new choice, and interest already recorded stays as it is; the agreement's log says who changed it and when.

NEW: THE SUCCESSION AND THE DECEASED'S REPAYMENT AGREEMENT — When a succession with the arrears passed to the heirs closes the repayment agreement of a deceased person who was honouring it, by default the agreement stays in good standing up to the death: in the deceased's interest proposal the days of the agreement stay out and, on the agreement's instalments, no more accrue from the death. In the succession preview you choose, with «L'accordo di rientro del defunto» (The deceased's repayment agreement): «resta in regola fino al decesso» (stays in good standing up to the death) or «vale come una decadenza» (counts as a lapse; the days of the agreement come back). The choice stays in the log of the transfer.

NEW: THE DECEASED'S INTEREST OR CHARGE WITH A REPORTED PAYMENT — If at the succession an interest or charge of the deceased has a payment reported from the portal and not yet verified, by default it stays with the deceased with its report, and the preview says so; with the checkbox in the preview you pass it to the heirs anyway, and the report remains to be verified. The sentence says how to record a real payment by the deceased. The choice stays in the log of the transfer.
NEW: THE LICENCE IN EVERY FILE — The program's source files carry the header with the AGPL-3.0-or-later licence, the author's name and the reference to the additional terms of the NOTICE file.

FIXED: SEARCHING PURCHASE INVOICES — When searching by supplier name, the purchase invoice list also showed that supplier's invoices in the other condominiums and ignored the status filters: now the search stays in the condominium and respects the filters.

FIXED: THE PORTAL — In the report and communication lists the cards have the dark theme colours (they were white); the hint for «Edit» and «Delete» says the word, no longer its code; the portal's «Modifica comunicazione» (edit communication) page has its title in the browser tab.

FIXED: INTEREST AND SUCCESSIONS FROM THE PREVIOUS VERSION — After a succession with the arrears passed to the heirs, the reminder for the deceased's interest and charges stayed «due» in the portal even though its share was closed, and the heirs did not have theirs: now they follow the shares, and cancelling the transfer puts everything back. Successions already recorded realign by themselves. A payment made on the same day as the repayment agreement, recorded before the agreement, no longer counts twice. After a succession, if a payment made by the deceased before the death is reversed, its reminder in the portal gives the correct remainder, no longer the previous amount.
